questions.question: What do Reddit r/startups, r/entrepreneur, and Indie Hackers threads identify as the top friction when first-time founders validate ideas, and do they express willingness to pay for a structured system versus free AI chatbots?
questions.rationale: This directly investigates Risk 2 (willingness to pay vs free alternatives) and satisfies the demand validation quota. Founder forums contain searchable complaints about fragmented validation workflows and spending intent.
search_queries: founders frustrated validating startup ideas Reddit
Indie Hackers pay for idea validation tool
free AI chatbot vs structured founder workflow

questions.question: How do first-time and solo founders currently sequence their validation work today — what specific tools, templates, and steps do they use, and where do they drop off or loop back?
questions.rationale: This satisfies the user behavior quota and addresses Risk 1 (flexibility vs rigid sequence) by revealing actual jobs-to-be-done. Public founder journey posts, build-in-public blogs, and YC/techstars guides are investigable sources.
search_queries: solo founder validation process step by step
how first time founders validate startup ideas
founder customer discovery workflow tools used

questions.question: What is the estimated market size and growth rate for founder enablement, idea validation, and pre-seed startup intelligence tools, and what do analyst reports or venture data say about spend at the earliest stages?
questions.rationale: Satisfies the market size quota. Early-stage founder tooling is a niche segment; reports from PitchBook, Gartner for SMB SaaS, and venture funding trend data can surface quantified estimates.
search_queries: pre seed founder tools market size 2024
startup idea validation software market growth
early stage founder enablement spending trends

questions.question: How do existing platforms like Crunchbase, Similarweb, SurveyMonkey, and Notion/AI chatbot combinations already serve founder validation workflows, and what gaps do user reviews cite?
questions.rationale: This is the primary competitor question (within the 2-slot cap) and directly investigates Risk 3 (data quality differentiation). Public reviews on G2, Capterra, and founder forum comparisons are searchable.
search_queries: Crunchbase vs founder validation workflow gaps
SurveyMonkey customer discovery founder reviews
Notion AI chatbot validate startup idea limitations

accelerator cohort completion retention rates
guided workflow SaaS retention single project

pre revenue founder subscription price sensitivity
solo founder SaaS pricing hesitation surveys
